entries.title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated November 2
entries.author: Kaivax
entries.excerpt: We’ve updated the previous post in this thread with some additions that were intended to be listed. Additional updates to Racial Abilities and Talents include: Orc Blood Fury’s cooldown reduced to 2 minutes (was 3 minutes). Troll Berserking duration increased to 15 seconds (was 10 seconds). entries.title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated November 2
entries.author: Kaivax
entries.excerpt: As we approach the launch of WoW Forever, we’ve been reflecting on feedback we’ve heard on racial abilities and passive traits: Some players have expressed that some of the new racial traits feel too generic, while others have raised concerns that some are objectively stronger than others.
